body:
Customer Service,

A conflicting Accounts Receivable task has been detected for "@Customer.Name@" (@Customer.CustomerID@) - Billing Group "@BillingGroup.Name@" (@BillingGroup.BillingGroupID@). This conflict could indicate one of three possibilities:

    1) There is an open AR task, yet an order tied to it has been paid
    2) There is a closed AR task, yet an order tied to it has a balance
    3) There is a new order with a balance, but no new AR task

Please investigate and feel free to ask the IT team any questions you may have.

Thank you,
-Reminder Mailer
